_meta.purpose: Structured, source-cited manufacturer facts for the independent Oxynova affiliate site. Values are manufacturer statements as published, NOT independently verified or endorsed. null = unknown/not stated. No inference, no price/pressure inferred from series number.
rules: Display null as 'Not stated by manufacturer', never as a guessed value.
Do not use any marketing/health-benefit string from this file as a site claim unless claims-register.md marks it VERIFIED and usable.
Conflicts between manufacturer pages are listed in 'conflicts' and must be shown as unresolved or omitted.
_meta.affiliateDestinationNote: HTTP 200, no redirect chain observed (curl -L, 0 redirects). The URL serves the manufacturer home page (canonical https://oxynova.com/) and AffiliateWP JavaScript on that page records the referral. HTTP http:// version 301s to https://.

usFDA.note: No FDA clearance/approval statement on any oxynova.com page reviewed. A web search found no Oxynova 510(k); the FDA 510(k) database itself was NOT queried directly. FDA states hyperbaric oxygen therapy devices are Class II devices cleared via 510(k) (Product Code CBF).

healthCanada.advisoryQuote: To date, Health Canada has not authorized any soft-shelled hyperbaric chamber for sale in Canada
healthCanada.advisoryQuote2: As a result, it is illegal to import, sell and advertise soft-shelled hyperbaric chambers in Canada.

healthCanada.note: Health Canada MDALL (licence listing) was not queried directly. Treat Canada as a high regulatory risk market; legal advice and manufacturer written clarification required before any Canadian advertising.

oxygenCompatibility.chamberLabelQuote: Not intended for use with enriched oxygen
oxygenCompatibility.chamberLabelSource: assets/reference/social-post-lifetime-warranty.jpg (Series 8 chamber side label, photographed on manufacturer artwork; not text on oxynova.com)
siteQuotes: OxyNova® hyperbaric chambers are environmentally sustainable, they are designed to be only used with ambient air, and deliver ± 93% Oxygen Purity (under pressure) with the help of the oxygen concentrator.
All metallic parts are made from special lab-grade and surgical-grade, 100% stainless steel, 100% compatible with oxygen.

The OxyNova® soft hyperbaric chambers are sealed technical infrastructures in which you breathe oxygen under 1.4 ATA pressure, in order to facilitate the delivery of extra oxygen for therapeutic, wellness and sports recovery purposes.
oxygenCompatibility.interpretation: UNRESOLVED. The site does not say how oxygen reaches the user (mask/cannula/other), whether any oxygen device may be placed or run inside the chamber, or what 'enriched oxygen' means in the label. Neither oxynova.com page reviewed contains the label wording. Do not publish or depict oxygen-enrichment, cannula or concentrator use. Ask manufacturer in writing.
